dimensions.threshold: concern below 80% operating cash flow / net profit (severity 4 below 50%)

dimensions.threshold: concern above 20% capital expenditure / revenue (severity 4 above 35%)

dimensions.statement: Technology is not a regulated sector, so the regulatory-framework prior does not apply.

evaluation.note: 2 of 3 applicable risk dimensions were evaluated and 1 could not be. No concern was raised by the dimensions that ran, and a partial evaluation is not a pass: the dimension that could not be evaluated is reported with its blocking inputs.

reading.misleading_before: POLICY_INPUTS_UNAVAILABLE said that the policy inputs were unavailable. On this issuer two of the three applicable dimensions had been evaluated and had passed; only leverage was blocked, by a net debt the filing does not present.
